predecessors.name: Later Yan
predecessors.text: the Longcheng remnant under Gao Yun and Feng Ba, the same cells as the Northern Yan 410 shape

successors.name: Northern Wei
successors.text: Northern Yan's realm: Longcheng (Helong) and Liaoxi, the Cliopatria 426 shape

ledger.x: 409: Feng Ba takes the throne at Longcheng and founds the Northern Yan.
432: the Wei open the war on the Northern Yan.
433: Feng Hong's sons hand Liaoxi Commandery to the Wei.
436: the Wei take Longcheng and the Northern Yan ends.
436: Northern Yan ends; Feng Hong's people are settled by Goguryeo at Pingguo and Beifeng and he is killed in 438.

wars.name: Wei-Yan clashes of 416 and 418
wars.outcome: 'In 416 and 418, Wei clashed with Yan'; no frontier change on the page.

wars.name: Northern Wei conquest of Northern Yan
wars.outcome: Taiwu attacks in fall 432 (10 commanderies surrender), Liaoxi is handed over in 433, a Wei invasion in 436 drives Feng Hong to Goguryeo; Liu Song named Feng Hong Prince of Yan and its vassal in 435 but sent little help.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line on the pages; the Liaoxi frontier is a commandery boundary the pages do not describe.
